design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 1 (country_home_loan_servicing).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed: {"task": 1, "key": "env_0053_agricultural_lending_cooperative/country_home_loan_servicing/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 5]}. Assignment: root homeloan_ext_escrow_waiver_fee takes 6 factors, homeloan_ext_escrow_waiver_paydown takes 5. Occupied by task 0: homeloan_ext_late_charge_reopened_month, homeloan_ext_returned_remittance_fee, homeloan_ext_replacement_remittance, homeloan_ext_escrow_shortage_paid_at_once and their four tools (fee assessments, replacement remittance, shortage lump sum). Claimed here: the escrow waiver write (record_escrow_waiver_439c8464, homeloan_escrow_waiver) and the member's curtailment (make_principal_paydown_d2fdfc16, homeloan_principal_payment curtailment) — disjoint events, policies and tools. This is the final task; the six policies are covered exactly once across the two scopes.

[Why it is a good test] The member asks only to drop escrow on her lake-cabin loan. The waiver rule waits on the loan meeting the escrow waiver loan-to-value limit, and for this loan the limit, the value and the balance tested are each moved by a rule: a second home carries a lower limit (raised for owners in good standing on a farm real estate loan), a young loan carries a seasoning margin, the homesite was released from the farm mortgage as a farmstead split at a lower appraisal that becomes the value, unpaid fees count in the tested balance, and the next autopay principal share counts as posted. The base reading (80% of original value, principal alone) says the loan already qualifies at 77.87%; the correct reading requires a paydown of 14838.42 first. The waiver fee then rests on six further rules. Difficulty comes from reading the two rules and the farm records, not from choosing a tool.

[Problem-tree card] root W = homeloan_ext_escrow_waiver_fee (agent). Edge W -> K (homeloan_ext_escrow_waiver_paydown), kind value_input, gate ltv, form action. Prerequisite sentence (W's rule): "When the tested balance is above the escrow waiver limit, the escrow waiver is not recorded until the member's paydown of the difference has been posted." Four-point test: connective 'not ... until' (negated direction, the way a booking is stated); waits on a named business action; no tool, id or code token; hard and conditional exactly as the condition field. fallback_reason: a lower principal can also come from a scheduled principal share or a replacement remittance's remainder, so the state does not single out the paydown. Seed falsity: tested 245302.81 less share 259.39 = 245043.42 above the limit amount 230205.00; no curtailment row. Resolver K is owner user: the paydown debits the member's own savings. Skipping it gives a fee of 808.49 instead of 729.11. One value_input edge (floor max(1-1,1) = 1). The charter's sentences run in both directions: task 0's 'is fixed only after' and 'is figured only after', this one's and task 0's 'is not figured until'.

[Base-invariant card] K writes homeloan_principal_payment: homeloan_payment_application gate homeloan_accepts_payments (status active; evidence the loan row's status and loan_id). W writes homeloan_escrow_waiver: homeloan_escrow_waiver_rule gate no_waiver_in_flood_zone (flood_zone outside_sfha). Prose conditions of the base waiver rule, all met at handling time: request on file (homeloan_requests escrow_waiver submitted 2026-11-16), mortgage insurance not in force (never placed, 80% original LTV), 28 payments due since closing (>= 12), no payment 30 or more days late in 12 months (July 2026 was 19 days late), no payment past due (accrued interest 0.00). The limit clause is replaced (declared in both policies' overwrite) by the waiver paydown rule's limit, value and tested balance; the fee clause by the waiver fee rule. No time-kind gate applies to either write.

[Business-object card] Loan 'Country Home 30-Year Fixed' on parcel 051-22618-0407, a second home. The value evidence is the farm parcel release row (farmstead_split, 2024-05-20, 298000.00) of the same parcel number, owned by the members' FarmLand loan; its mortgage row (2014-12-19, 41000.00, the lot as part of the farm) is the release's source. Unpaid fee: the July 2026 late charge 15.00 only. No extra principal payment before the call, so the fee basis tier is set only by the paydown of this call.

[Factor card — K, paydown 14838.42] waiver_limit (parameter, cross-difficulty farmland, multi-source): second home + active farm loan with four installments paid 2025-01-01..2026-07-01 (none returned) and no farm late charge -> 77.5; baseline 80 -> 7388.42. seasoning_margin (parameter): 29 months -> 0.25; baseline 0 -> 14093.42. waiver_value (method, cross-difficulty farmland): farmstead split release 298000.00 < 315000.00 -> 298000.00; baseline original value -> 1705.92; near-miss: the parcel's mortgage row (41000.00) is not a release and does not count. tested_balance (method): escrow balance 3161.96 not below zero, 15.00 of fees unpaid -> 245302.81; baseline -> 14823.42. principal_to_post (method): autopay, next due in 13 days and not the final payment -> one share 259.39; baseline -> 15097.81. Whole baseline 0.00 (the base reading needs no paydown).
[Factor card — W, fee 729.11] fee_rate_band (parameter, cross-difficulty farmland): loan-to-value against the waiver value (lower of 315000.00 and the 298000.00 farmstead-split appraisal) 77.33% after the paydown -> 0.35; baseline 0.25 -> 570.35; before the paydown it would be 82.31% (band 0.40). occupancy_addon (parameter): second home financed 29 months ago -> 0.125; baseline 0 -> 530.66. member_owner_discount (parameter, cross-difficulty equity, multi-source): Class B active, patronage 2026-03-13 -> 30%; baseline 0 -> 1052.30. seasoning_credit (parameter): 29 months, a late charge in 24 months (so not the 60-month tier), twelve scheduled payments and no return in 12 months -> 10%; baseline 0 -> 812.90. fee_basis (method): a loan open fewer than 60 months is priced on its original principal, 252000.00; baseline principal balance -> 664.62. autopay_credit (parameter): autopay, no return in 24 months -> 25.00; baseline 0 -> 754.11. Whole baseline 576.12.

[Seed] Customer (joint, farm operators near Ogallala), FarmLand 25-Year Fixed with four semiannual installments, its parcel mortgage and farmstead-split release rows, Class B Voting Stock with a 2026-03-13 patronage payment, the cabin loan, its monthly bills and payments 2025-10 to 2026-11 (online banking until July 2026, automatic debit from August), the July late charge, escrow deposits (438.57, then 452.18 from the June analysis), the 2025 Keith County tax and the 2026-27 homeowner's premium, and the escrow waiver request. Ledger rows before 2025-10 are not loaded; the loan row's balances are the official running totals. The July late charge was figured under the same late-charge rule task 0 uses (3%, 70% relief, 15.00 floor). No automatic clause fires: no payment is past due, no analysis is due before June 2027, no mortgage insurance exists; the escrow balance is refunded by the refund run after the waiver and is not part of this tree.

[Persona] Patrice is brisk and organised; she volunteers the goal and that she filed the online form; credentials, the July lateness and the autopay start only when asked; she agrees to a paydown and approves exactly the amount stated only after the agent raises it; she accepts the fee quoted; she ends once the waiver is confirmed. She never mentions value, limits or paydowns first.

[Standard solution and verification] Reads: find_customers (phone), verify (phone + member number), find_homeloan_loans, find_homeloan_requests, find_homeloan_transactions, find_homeloan_escrow, find_farmland_loans, find_farmland_transactions, find_farmland_parcels, find_equity_accounts, find_equity_transactions. Writes: hand over the paydown, member approves 14838.42; record the waiver with fee 729.11. Harness (real tools replayed to each step, policy compute evaluated as check_compute does): K 14838.42 (7388.42 / 14093.42 / 1705.92 / 14823.42 / 15097.81, baseline 0); W 729.11 (570.35 / 530.66 / 1052.30 / 812.90 / 664.62 / 754.11, baseline 576.12); W without K 808.49.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] The waiver rule states its own fee and waits on the paydown to the limit; the paydown rule states the limit (occupancy and farm standing), the margin (loan age), the value (farmstead split release), the tested balance (unpaid fees and any escrow advance) and the principal to post (autopay timing). From the loan row, the farm parcel and ledger rows and the equity rows a reader reaches 14838.42 and then 729.11, the same as gold.

[Revisions] r1: the occupancy add-on first read only the occupancy field, which is not record evidence for a tier; it was tied to the loan's age as a second home (financed under 36 months / 36 or more), and the rule text and compute were changed together.

[Revisions r2 — audit round 2] F-6/T1-F2: the principal-to-post ladder no longer turns on escrow-analysis distance; its second tier is now the final scheduled payment (all principal posts), a base rule. F-19/T1-F1: the waiver fee no longer says a paydown does not lower the fee; the fee is priced on the original principal for a loan open under 60 months (the loan amount, as a waiver price adjustment is set), on principal plus any escrow advance for an older loan with a negative escrow balance, else on principal, while the rate band reads loan-to-value on the principal after the paydown against the waiver value, so one reading only and the paydown lowers the fee through the band (808.49 -> 729.11). F-18: the band no longer carries the unreachable under-12-months clause. F-16: the second state-form wording naming the paydown rule was removed; the limit clause is replaced by the prerequisite sentence itself. F-17: the edge effect is general text. F-9/F-10: no longer apply (the fee basis does not read curtailments; no escrow-analysis timing). T1-F3: flips_to_true_by recomputed (230123.08 at or below 230205.00). T1-O1: the persona no longer mentions the farmstead split. T1-O2: the edge condition now names the tested balance. Value moved: W 709.02 -> 729.11; K unchanged 14838.42.

[Revisions r3 — audit round 3, charter only] F-18: the paydown's tested balance no longer has a past-due tier (a customer the base waiver refuses); its first tier is now a negative escrow balance, whose advance the member owes once escrow closes. N-4: the fee band's waiver value now follows the paydown rule's value, including the large-homesite haircut. N-3: farm installments paid are principal payments less returns (here 4 less 0). Seasoning wording: the 12-month window now governs both payments booked and returns. No value moved in this task: K 14838.42, W 729.11, every sensitivity and baseline unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Patrice M. Wiebe. You and your husband Arlen farm near Ogallala, Nebraska, and the Country Home loan you are calling about is on your lake cabin at 1186 Arthur Bay Road on Lake McConaughy. You are organised, polite and a little brisk, the one in the house who keeps the paperwork. On Sunday you filled out the online form asking to stop escrow on the cabin loan, and you are calling to get that done: from now on the two of you want to pay the cabin's property taxes and homeowner's insurance yourselves instead of having them run through the loan. You are fine with the agent doing whatever has to be done on their side. When the agent asks who you are, give the phone number on the membership, 4024642209, and if they need more, the member number CPF-4802264. Only if they ask for anything else do you give the last four of Arlen's Social Security number, 6913, or your email, patrice.wiebe@keithcountynet.com. If they ask, the automatic payments started in August, and the July payment went in a few days late because you were at the fair. If the agent tells you the loan has to be paid down to a certain level before escrow can be dropped, say that is fine, you have savings at the credit union for it; when they tell you the amount and send you the payment to approve, approve exactly that amount. If the agent tells you there is a fee for waiving escrow, accept the fee they quote. Once the agent tells you escrow has been waived, thank them and end the call.

edges.fallback_reason: The state the waiver waits on is a principal balance at or below the limit, but a lower principal balance can also be brought about by a scheduled principal share or by the remainder of a replacement remittance, so the state alone does not single out the member's paydown; the sentence names the paydown itself.
edges.condition: the tested balance on homeloan_loans (principal balance, plus unpaid fees and any escrow advance where the paydown rule adds them) less the scheduled principal still to post is at or below the escrow waiver limit amount, a homeloan_principal_payment row with payment_purpose curtailment having been posted for the difference
edges.policy_source: When the tested balance is above the escrow waiver limit, the escrow waiver is not recorded until the member's paydown of the difference has been posted.
